ORDERING IS DELIBERATE. This file is pushed AFTER PR #12799 was opened and
un-drafted, not before. Pushing the arming file first is what produced the

and a PR opened by claude-pr-automerge receives no required checks until
something is pushed to it afterwards -- PI-20260923-JN54P2HH-0002, measured
across all six PRs this session opened through that route. This push is that
something: it arms the route and attaches the required suite in one act.
